summary: The B3-S3 legacy salvage returned nothing usable, which put Area 3 six questions short of the Issue #91 minimum even on the assumption that every unaudited question passes. Tranche B3-F answers that measured deficit with sixteen new Area-3 questions, MA-Q-0391 through MA-Q-0406.

trigger.result: LEGAL KEEP 7 / MINOR_EDIT 1, all eight Existing_Answer_Correct YES; REALISM PASS 0 / FAIL 8 (MAJOR_REWRITE 7, DELETE 1)
trigger.failure_pattern: near-clones of released items, bare number recall, and options recoverable from their own wording without legal knowledge -- the same structural weakness recorded for B3-S2

measured_position_before_b3f.method: counted from the canonical records, assuming every unaudited B3-D v2 and B3-E v2 question passes its audit and the two hash-stale B3-C items are restored
measured_position_before_b3f.note: Area 3 is the binding constraint and the total is short as well. No amount of audit success elsewhere closes it.

why_not_repair_b3s2.governing_instruction: Issue #91 STEP 10 keeps B3-S2 off the critical path unless a measured Area deficit cannot otherwise be satisfied.
why_not_repair_b3s2.assessment: The deficit is real, so S2 became eligible for reconsideration. It was still rejected: BATCH3-S2-REPAIR-PLAN.json records 12 of 16 Area-3 S2 questions as MAJOR_REWRITE, which is re-authoring under a heavier burden, since each rewrite must also escape the distinct_from_bank findings already recorded against it. Authoring from propositions no rule in the bank has cited is both faster and stronger.
why_not_repair_b3s2.s2_status: unchanged; history and repair plan preserved

source_census.capacity_check: Area 3 holds 124 free family slots across 87 families, so slot capacity was never the constraint.
source_census.rules_never_used: 0 -- every Area-3 rule in the bank already carries at least one question, so a top-up had to come from propositions the bank had not yet reduced to rules.
source_census.method: 247 CMR 9.00 was retrieved as the official PDF and every 9.xx section compared against the authority citations of every existing rule.
further_primary_sources: M.G.L. c. 94C s. 18(d), (d1/2) and (d3/4), s. 18D and s. 21, read on malegislature.gov 2026-08-20
21 CFR 208.24 and 208.26, read through the eCFR API 2026-08-20
105 CMR 700.012(A)(1), (A)(2) and (C)(8), read in the official PDF 2026-08-20
source_census.novelty_probe: Each of the nineteen candidate propositions was regex-probed against the stem and every option of all 390 existing questions. Nine returned no hit at all. Ten returned hits that were inspected question by question; two were dropped as too close -- 247 CMR 9.04(4) bed-side delivery against MA-Q-0227, and the M.G.L. c. 94C s. 18(d) out-of-state verification duty against MA-Q-0013, MA-Q-0020 and MA-Q-0027. Sixteen survived.

rejected_on_the_record.reason: MA-Q-0227 already keys that bed-side medications must reach the patient or the patient's agent, and carries a consent distractor
three released questions already work this pathway

rejected_on_the_record.proposition: M.G.L. c. 94C s. 5 excepted preparation retail sale
rejected_on_the_record.reason: MA-Q-0121 is a SATA already covering identification, record and the four-ounce limit together
the mirror image of MA-Q-0107's 60 mg exception

composition.why_sixteen: Six close the deficit. B3-C lost 2 of 33 to audit attrition, about 6 percent; sixteen leaves margin at roughly double that rate and lifts the total above 360 as well. Every one of the sixteen rests on a distinct primary proposition, so none is filler.

structural_targets.note: The tranche deliberately carries three-correct SATA items, the pattern BATCH3-SATA-PATTERN-CORRECTION records as surviving site/shuffle.js. An initial draft came out with keys A1 B2 C3 D5 E0 and two items where the correct option was the only hedged one; both were corrected before the tranche was applied.

projection_after_b3f.caution: Area 1 sits exactly on its minimum with no margin, and Area 2 has one. Neither has an unaudited candidate outstanding, so neither can absorb a loss. Both are already audited and released, so no further attrition is expected there.

governance_note_for_issue_91.id_range: MA-Q-0391..MA-Q-0406 extends beyond the B3-E reservation of MA-Q-0361..MA-Q-0390, which was fully consumed by the B3-E v2 expansion. Allocating further sequential identifiers is ordinary authoring and changes no blueprint quantity.
governance_note_for_issue_91.prior_projections_preserved: The original B3-E projection and the B3-E v2 measured adaptive outcome both stand. This record appends the B3-F outcome; it replaces nothing.
